Release 1.0: Initial Release
Release 1.1: Fixed the hinge to allow it to slot down (OOPS)

This pistol stabilizing brace was originally designed for the DAEDALUS project. It has been revised to fit the DB Alloy with a custom hinge and brace bodies. This version is not compatible directly with the DAEDALUS anymore and is a standalone version for the DB ALLOY.

It comes in standard length, +1", and +2". It also comes with two dropped versions where the brace is lower than the standard version for better cheek weld.  

ONLY COMPATIBLE WITH DB ALLOY and may interfere with 3rd party objects and accessories, hardware, or any design that is a modification of the original design.
